drhp.business: Sadbhav Engineering Limited (SEL) is an EPC company executing national and state highway projects, expressway packages, canal and irrigation works, and excavation and overburden removal contracts for major public sector undertakings. The roads and highways segment is the mainstay of operations, with the Company also active in irrigation infrastructure and mining.
drhp.end_markets: Road and highway infrastructure (NHAI, MoRTH, state road development corporations)|Irrigation infrastructure|Mining operations (excavation and overburden removal for public sector undertakings)
drhp.expansion: No new capacity, plant or expansion project narrative is disclosed. The year was one of consolidation and course-correction, with the Company focused on completion and closure of legacy projects, settlement of claims, and preparation for re-entry into active bidding for EPC and Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) projects, rather than new capex or expansion.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Company is mid-transition through a debt restructuring arrangement with lending banks; financial flexibility remains constrained until the plan is fully implemented.
- Volatility in prices of key inputs such as bitumen, cement, steel and fuel can affect project economics.
- The Company's business is concentrated with NHAI, MoRTH and state road development/irrigation authorities, a narrow customer base.
- Delays in realisation of claims and arbitration awards affect recovery of amounts owed to the Company.
- Flagged generically by management as a key risk category within its risk management framework.
- Exerts pressure on margins as the Company re-enters active bidding.
- Can affect project timelines for road and highway projects.
- During the transition period of the restructuring, availability of bank guarantees and working capital limits is constrained, limiting the Company's ability to bid for and execute new projects.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Concentrate on securing road infrastructure projects and on timely execution of every project undertaken.
- Selective bidding for road EPC projects where the Company enjoys established pre-qualifications.
- Efficient and disciplined cash flow management, deploying capital towards execution, debt servicing and value creation.
- Rebuild a healthy and sustainable order book as the primary objective for the coming years.
- Faithful implementation of the debt restructuring plan and timely servicing of restructured obligations.
